title: Decide next BeadsForm branch milestones (multiple choice)
goal: Choose the next milestone order and settle key product constraints before agents continue implementation.
description:
Recent wins are now complete or approved: preview dependency bootstrap, authoring/refinement commands, file-plus-pipe BeadsForm authoring, and `vibe-agent send --stdin`. The branch is dogfoodable again and the remaining open work is mostly product sequencing.

This revised form uses multiple-choice questions only. Add nuance in the per-choice notes textareas when needed.

allowCodeFileChanges.allowLabel: Submit and allow agents to implement the chosen next milestone
allowCodeFileChanges.avoidLabel: Submit planning only; do not change files yet
allowCodeFileChanges.description: Choose whether agents may continue implementing after processing this response. Weekly-dev merge, branch deletion, and workspace closure are still not authorized by this form.

questions.title: What should be the next implementation milestone?
questions.description: Select the milestone agents should do next. You can select multiple if you want a combined slice, but each selected item should still pass review2 and independent tester before moving to the next milestone.

choices.label: M1: Server-side draft persistence first
choices.description: Start with beads-web-q4ep — Persist BeadsForm progress on the server.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Highest protection against user data loss and foundational for cross-device/cross-browser form progress.

pros: Unblocks cleaner future handling for Next Instruction and in-progress wizard state.
Makes BeadsForms safer for long forms and mobile sessions.
cons: Highest implementation risk: storage, scope, conflict handling, localStorage reconciliation, and submit cleanup.

choices.label: M1: Pending queue usability first
choices.description: Batch beads-web-xq5 — Sort/filter pending BeadsForms queue and beads-web-nwj — Show branch and VK workspace context on pending BeadsForms.

pros: Should not touch submit or draft persistence paths.
cons: Does not address draft loss or submit-state concerns.

choices.label: M1: Wizard/mobile navigation first
choices.description: Do beads-web-vx9 — Improve BeadsForm wizard keyboard and mobile navigation before storage/submit changes.

cons: Does not solve draft persistence or pending queue discoverability.

choices.label: M1: Submit/handoff UX first
choices.description: Do beads-web-czy — Improve BeadsForm optimistic submit UI and/or beads-web-6xff — Add BeadsForm Next Instruction prompt.

pros: Improves final moment of form filling and post-submit handoff.
cons: Touches submit semantics, XML, clipboard, notification, aggregate, and failure states.

choices.label: M1: Structured clarification-agent chain first
choices.description: Continue yhk2/n11w/pyi2/x0po/fqb/loiz/lix before more BeadsForm UX work.

cons: Security/transport-sensitive and should remain serial with strict review; likely slower than product UI wins.

questions.title: If server-side drafts are next, what policy should they use?
questions.description: This applies to `beads-web-q4ep — Persist BeadsForm progress on the server`. Choose the intended draft source-of-truth and cleanup behavior.

choices.label: Server draft is authoritative when available
choices.description: On load, newest valid server draft wins over localStorage unless the user explicitly chooses otherwise.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Matches the current bead goal: server draft should be authoritative and localStorage should be cache/fallback.

choices.label: Server draft is backup only
choices.description: Keep localStorage primary and use server draft only when local draft is absent.

choices.label: Ask the user on local/server conflict
choices.description: If both local and server drafts exist and differ, show a restore choice instead of auto-picking.

choices.label: Newest updatedAt wins automatically
choices.description: Use revision/updatedAt conflict checks and pick the newest valid draft without prompting.

choices.label: Archive draft on successful submit
choices.description: Keep a non-active archived copy for recovery/debug after submitted response is saved.

choices.label: Delete/clear draft on successful submit
choices.description: Remove the active draft after successful submission to prevent stale restore.

questions.title: How should server drafts be scoped for privacy and collaboration?
questions.description: Choose the intended privacy/collaboration model. The key must prevent leaks across users, repos, forms, and workspaces.

choices.label: Scope by workspace/repo/bead/form plus current user or session
choices.description: Each user/session has their own draft for a form.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Safest default for privacy and prevents agents/humans from overwriting one another.

choices.label: One shared draft per bead/form
choices.description: Anyone with access to the form sees/continues the same in-progress draft.

choices.label: Scope by creating session when available
choices.description: Tie drafts to the agent/session that created or opened the form.

choices.label: Pause q4ep for a short design pass first
choices.description: Do not implement server drafts until identity/scope/storage location is designed.

questions.title: What should optimistic submit say before durable persistence?
questions.description: For `beads-web-czy — Improve BeadsForm optimistic submit UI`, current behavior waits for backend persistence before showing success and starting XML clipboard copy. Choose the preferred correctness/UX boundary.

choices.label: Show “Saving…” until persistence, then “Submitted”
choices.description: Optimistically lock answers and start clipboard copy, but avoid saying saved/submitted until persistence succeeds.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Balances immediate feedback with correctness about durable save.

choices.label: Show “Submitted” immediately with rollback on failure
choices.description: Treat submit as optimistically successful and change only if persistence fails.

choices.label: Copy XML immediately before persistence completes
choices.description: Build XML from normalized local values and copy right away, then update warnings/status based on persistence result.

choices.label: Copy only after persistence succeeds
choices.description: Keep current correctness boundary for clipboard copy.

questions.title: How should “Next Instruction” be stored and handed off?
questions.description: This applies to `beads-web-6xff — Add BeadsForm "Next Instruction" prompt`. The field should appear near final/review submit buttons and tell the agent what to do after processing the form response.

choices.label: Store as a structured submitted response field
choices.description: Persist next_instruction as part of normalized response values and include it in XML/clipboard/notification.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Most reliable for downstream processing and replay.

choices.label: Include in handoff/notification only
choices.description: Do not store it as an answer field; use it only to guide immediate post-submit processing.

choices.label: Omit when empty
choices.description: No empty XML node or notification text if the user leaves it blank.

choices.label: Show only on final question and review step
choices.description: Keep it out of earlier questions to reduce distraction.

choices.label: Explicitly constrain by allow_code_file_changes
choices.description: If code/file changes are disallowed, the next instruction may guide discussion/planning only.

questions.title: If pending queue polish is next, what should it prioritize?
questions.description: This applies to `beads-web-xq5 — Sort/filter pending BeadsForms queue` and `beads-web-nwj — Show branch and VK workspace context on pending BeadsForms`.

choices.label: Default sort by most recently updated/pending first
choices.description: Prioritize forms with recent activity.

choices.label: Group by readable workspace/branch context
choices.description: Make it easier to distinguish similar forms across branches.

choices.label: Add repo/workspace filters
choices.description: Let users narrow the pending queue.

choices.label: Hard gate: no broad scans or bulk bd show
choices.description: Any implementation must preserve existing pending queue scan/cache guarantees.
choices.is_recommended_reason: This was repeatedly important in prior review.

choices.label: Defer pending queue polish
choices.description: Do draft/submit/wizard work first.

questions.title: Which embedding/documentation work should happen soon?
questions.description: Recent discussion clarified that Markdown/media refs should be repo/cwd-relative or explicit staging-root based, not .beads/attachments-first. Select the embedding follow-ups that should be prioritized.

choices.label: Support repo-relative Markdown/media/file refs
choices.description: Prioritize beads-web-btnf — Allow repo-relative Markdown file attachments in BeadsForms.

choices.label: Document all embedding features in skill and CLI
choices.description: Prioritize beads-web-rsyb — Document all BeadsForm embedding features in skill and CLI.

choices.label: Remove .beads/attachments-first guidance
choices.description: Assume new authoring should never require .beads/attachments.

choices.label: Support explicit temporary/staging folders
choices.description: Allow refs to files in an explicit staging root when needed, without hardcoded /tmp guidance.

questions.title: How should the next work be batched?
questions.description: Choose how aggressively agents should combine upcoming beads. Smaller slices reduce review risk; batching related UI surfaces can reduce duplicate testing.

choices.label: Do server drafts alone
choices.description: Keep beads-web-q4ep isolated because it is stateful and risky.
choices.is_recommended_reason: Tester strongly recommended q4ep as a separate milestone.

choices.label: Batch optimistic submit + Next Instruction
choices.description: Combine beads-web-czy and beads-web-6xff because they touch the same submit/handoff surfaces.

choices.label: Batch pending queue sort/filter + context
choices.description: Combine beads-web-xq5 and beads-web-nwj as pending-list display work.

choices.label: Batch embedding behavior + docs
choices.description: Combine beads-web-btnf and beads-web-rsyb if implementation and docs are naturally coupled.

choices.label: Do wizard/mobile navigation alone
choices.description: Keep keyboard/mobile behavior isolated for easier accessibility testing.

choices.label: Defer plugin refactor until behavior stabilizes
choices.description: Keep beads-web-hb7 as a later refactor-only milestone.

choices.label: Keep clarification-agent chain serial
choices.description: Do yhk2/n11w/pyi2/x0po/fqb/loiz/lix in strict order with separate review/test gates.

questions.title: What permissions and constraints apply after this form?
questions.description: Confirm what agents may do after processing this response. This form does not authorize weekly-dev merge, branch deletion, or workspace closure unless explicitly stated here.

choices.label: Continue autonomously through selected milestones
choices.description: Proceed serially with implementer, review2, and tester cycles for each selected milestone.

choices.label: Ask me between milestones
choices.description: Stop after each milestone is tester-approved before starting the next.

choices.label: Implementation/code changes are allowed
choices.description: Agents may edit code/docs/tests for selected tasks.

choices.label: Planning only for now
choices.description: Do not implement after this response; summarize and wait.

choices.label: No weekly-dev merge authorization
choices.description: Do not merge to weekly-dev based on this response alone.
